measurement_contract.shell: A /bin/sh child of the workflow bash step measured its inherited soft/hard open-file limits; the step passed those values to the Node24 action as inputs.
measurement_contract.node24: The Node24 action invoked a bounded /bin/sh child; that child measured its own inherited soft/hard limits. This is not an in-process Node resource-limit reading.
measurement_contract.no_adjustment: The probe did not request a limit change. It reports the two execution chains; it does not identify which layer changed the limit.
measurement_contract.hard_limit_normalization: The probe normalizes shell text unlimited to the closed summary value infinity.

source_gate.contract: prepare_spawn calls prepare_spawn_below with the fixed ceiling. Lines 512–519 return WorkerUnavailable if getrlimit fails, the supplied ceiling is nonpositive (unreachable with the fixed production constant), the soft limit exceeds the ceiling, or any enumerated descriptor is at/above the ceiling. A hard limit of infinity alone is not this predicate.
source_gate.conditional_application: The observed Node24-child soft limit 1048575 exceeds 65536; if inherited unchanged by a Marmish process reaching this guard, it would fail this soft-limit predicate. The shell soft limit 10240 does not exceed this ceiling. The probe did not execute the guard or enumerate the original engine descriptors. The engine reads its own in-process resource limit when prepare_spawn executes; the actual intervening limit history was not measured.

This does not prove identical machines, process ancestry, environment, installed components or all runner properties.
previous_failure_comparison.unavailable: The prior failed job did not retain its actual Marmish engine RLIMIT_NOFILE or a matching engine error in these records.
